scenes.title: The Question
scenes.description: A young detective discovers a mysterious message in a quiet city at night.
scenes.dialogue: Why would someone leave this here?
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime cinematic night street, young detective, mysterious envelope, dramatic moonlight, detailed background

scenes.title: The Signal
scenes.description: A strange electronic signal appears on an old monitor.
scenes.dialogue: That signal... it is still active.
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime laboratory, CRT monitor displaying mysterious signal, blue night lighting, cinematic composition

scenes.title: The Chase
scenes.description: The detective runs through narrow streets while following the signal.
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime action sequence, detective running through narrow city streets, motion blur, dramatic perspective

scenes.title: The Door
scenes.description: The signal leads to an abandoned building with a locked underground door.
scenes.dialogue: So this is where it ends.
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime abandoned building, underground metal door, flashlight beam, deep shadows, cinematic suspense

scenes.title: The Truth
scenes.description: The door opens and reveals a hidden room filled with evidence.
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime hidden investigation room, evidence boards, photographs, documents, dramatic reveal lighting

scenes.title: YESNO
scenes.description: The detective looks toward the sunrise, holding the final piece of evidence.
scenes.dialogue: There are only two answers: yes or no.
scenes.visual_prompt: 1990s Japanese anime cinematic sunrise, detective standing on rooftop holding evidence, city skyline, emotional final shot
